disposition_reason: Three commercial matcha powders were analysed for Hg, Cd, Pb and trace elements, with ice tea leaching values; Hg was quantified and Cd and Pb were below the 1.00 µg/g LOQ.

study.design: Laboratory analysis of three commercial matcha powders, their in vitro non-digestible residues and ice teas made by three methods
study.origin: one product of Japanese origin, two of Chinese origin
study.market: health food stores in Zlín, Czech Republic
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; FAAS (Na, Mg, K, Ca, Mn, Fe, Zn, Se), ETAAS (Cd, Pb); AMA-254 for Hg
lod: LOQ Cd 1.00 µg/g, Pb 1.00 µg/g, Se 0.15 µg/g, Fe 6.00 µg/g, Zn 5 µg/g, Mn 50 µg/g
study.qa: CRMs INCT-TL-1 tea leaves and IAEA-336 lichen; recoveries 88-109%
